title: Register and audit care providers once across aged care, disability and veterans' care
action: Give providers working in aged care, the NDIS and veterans' care one registration and one set of audits, starting with mutual recognition of each sector's registration and audits, and a single portal for registration, approvals and audits.
why: Providers that work in more than one care sector are registered and audited separately for each, at real cost and with no gain in safety; the new Aged Care Act has already moved registration closer to the NDIS.

evidence.source: Delivering quality care more efficiently: Inquiry report
evidence.quote: establish cross-sectoral registration and audits across the aged care, NDIS and veterans' care sectors, with mutual recognition of registration and audits as an interim step

tradeoffs: Sectors differ in risk and in who they serve, so a common registration still needs sector-specific requirements.
